`exported.jpg` is a synthetic 192×128 RGB pattern generated for this repository.
It is a progressive JPEG exported at quality 93, with an sRGB ICC profile, EXIF
orientation/copyright, and a JPEG comment. It contains no personal photograph.
The media tests compare its entire bytes, protecting both image data and metadata
from accidental processing or stripping. Pillow was used to create this fixture;
it is not needed to run the application or tests.
